basic_info.description: Nestled in one of San Francisco's most sought after neighborhoods, this spacious and beautifully laid out 2-bedroom, 1-bath corner lot Art Deco home offers an exceptional living experience for all home seekers. Flooded with natural light in every room from large double-paned windows, the home features bright and generously sized bedrooms, and a large separate dining room perfect for entertaining guests. Recently refinished hardwood floors flow throughout, creating a warm and inviting atmosphere. The sophisticated fireplace adds to the warm feel, while fresh paint throughout ensures the home's inviting atmosphere. This home also includes a large garage offering secure parking and ample storage. Located just steps from the vibrant Cole Street shopping, dining, and entertainment district, this home is perfectly positioned for enjoying all that San Francisco has to offer. Public transportation is close by, making it easy to explore the city. Whether you're relaxing at home or entertaining guests, this property offers a perfect blend of comfort, convenience, and urban beauty. It is a must see!
